## 1. System Architecture

CQ-HECS operates as a classical quantum state emulator and constraint satisfaction solver.

```
                              +-------------------------------------------+
                              |    Vulkan Workload & Entropy Scheduler    |
                              |    - Queue Submissions & Memory Barriers  |
                              |    - Hardware Entropy & Workload Routing  |
                              +---------------------+---------------------+
                                                    |
          +-------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------+
          |                   |                     |                     |                   |
+---------v---------+ +-------v---------+ +---------v---------+ +---------v---------+ +-------v---------+
|  J-Space Alpha    | |  J-Space Beta   | |  J-Space Gamma    | |  J-Space Delta    | |  J-Space Epsilon  |
|  (ARX Modulo)     | |  (Phase Ring)   | |  (SAT & Cuckoo)   | |  (Residual SVD)   | | (Explosion Shield)|
|  A + B Linearize  | |  Exact Ring     | |  DIMACS CNF Solve | |  MPS Area-Law     | |  Lyapunov Monitor |
|  Carry Shadow     | |  Clifford + T   | |  O(1) Loop Prune  | |  OpenQASM 2.0/3.0 | |  3-Number Compres |
|  Overflow Reverse | |  Interference   | |  Hilbert Mix      | |  Re-Inflation     | |  0-Bit Loss Round |
+-------------------+ +-----------------+ +-------------------+ +-------------------+ +-----------------+
                                                    |
                              +---------------------v---------------------+
                              |   Vulkan 1.3 Compute & Tiered Memory      |
                              |   - Embedded SPIR-V Shaders in Binary     |
                              |   - Cross-Vendor (AMD, Intel, NVIDIA, Mac)|
                              |   - Active VRAM strictly < 120 MB         |
                              |   - Win32 / POSIX Tiered Swap Pool        |
                              |   - Isolated Deterministic Forward Oracle |
                              +-------------------------------------------+
```

### J-Space Alpha (ARX Carry-Shadow Separation)
Decomposes 64-bit addition into linear and carry terms:
- `Sum(A, B) = A ^ B`
- `CarryShadow(A, B) = (A & B) << 1`
- `(A + B) mod 2^64 = Sum(A, B) + CarryShadow(A, B) mod 2^64`
Algebraic verification testbench for BLAKE2b G-function (12 rounds), ChaCha20 quarter-round (20 rounds), and SHA-256 schedule expansion (64 rounds).

### J-Space Beta (Exact Giles-Selinger Ring Z[1/sqrt(2), i] & Z_8 Phase Ring)
Exact cyclotomic and Giles-Selinger ring arithmetic. Maps Clifford + T quantum state phases without floating-point cancellation drift:
- Constructive interference: (k1 - k2) == 0 mod 8
- Destructive interference: (k1 - k2) == 4 mod 8 (exact 0.0 residual without float cancellation)
- Unitary adjoint inversion: U^dagger U = Identity

### J-Space Gamma (DIMACS SAT & O(1) Cuckoo Pruning)
DPLL solver for propositional satisfiability. Computes 64-bit Murmur3 state signatures and caches branch states in a dual-bucket Cuckoo hash table to prune cycle loops in O(1) time.

### J-Space Delta (300-Qubit MPS Tensor Chain)
1D Matrix Product State with 300 sites and maximum bond dimension chi=64. Truncated SVD stores singular values above chi in a residual cache (Lambda_res), allowing lossless re-inflation.

### J-Space Epsilon (Explosion Shield & Compression)
Lyapunov exponent monitor: lambda = (1 / dt) * ln(||delta x(t)|| / ||delta x(0)||). If lambda > 2.5, applies stabilizing unitary deflation. Lossless 3-number compression achieves 100% bit identity roundtrips across 64-bit boundaries.

---

## 2. Public C-ABI Interface (`include/cq_hecs_api.h`)

```c
typedef struct cq_context cq_context_t;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t gate_count;
    uint32_t qubit_count;
    double   elapsed_ms;
    double   active_vram_mb;
    double   lambda_res;
    int      success;
} cq_result_t;

typedef struct {
    int      satisfiable;      // 1 = SAT, 0 = UNSAT
    uint32_t num_vars;
    uint32_t num_clauses;
    uint32_t decisions;
    uint32_t pruned_cycles;
    double   elapsed_ms;
    int      verified;
    int8_t   assignment[1024]; // 1 = True, 0 = False, -1 = Unassigned
} cq_sat_result_t;

CQ_API cq_context_t* cq_create_context(uint32_t num_qubits, uint32_t bond_dim);
CQ_API int cq_execute_qasm(cq_context_t* ctx, const char* qasm_str, cq_result_t* out_result);
CQ_API int cq_solve_sat(const char* cnf_str, cq_sat_result_t* out_result);
CQ_API int cq_invert_arx(const char* primitive, uint32_t rounds, const uint64_t* target, uint64_t* out_preimage);
CQ_API void cq_destroy_context(cq_context_t* ctx);
CQ_API const char* cq_get_version(void);
CQ_API double cq_get_active_vram_mb(cq_context_t* ctx);
```

---

## 3. CLI Command Cheat Sheet & Exit Codes

```powershell
# OpenQASM Simulation
cq_hecs.exe qasm benchmarks\qasm\ghz_300.qasm --json
Get-Content circuit.qasm | cq_hecs.exe qasm - --json | ConvertFrom-Json

# SAT Constraint Solving
cq_hecs.exe sat benchmarks\sat\pigeonhole_6_5.cnf --json
# Exit codes: 0 = SAT, 10 = UNSAT, 1 = Error

# ARX Cryptanalysis Inversion / Verification Testbench
cq_hecs.exe arx blake2b --rounds 12 --json | ConvertFrom-Json
cq_hecs.exe arx chacha20 --rounds 20 --json | ConvertFrom-Json
cq_hecs.exe arx sha256 --rounds 64 --json | ConvertFrom-Json

# Stress Test
cq_hecs.exe stress --cycles 100000 --json | ConvertFrom-Json

# Interactive TUI Monitor
cq_hecs.exe dashboard [--cycles N]

# Self-Test
cq_hecs.exe test --json | ConvertFrom-Json
```
